company_name: Shanghai Rhyme New Energy Technology Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company provides core equipment and system engineering solutions specifically for semiconductor materials and related high-tech industries.
summary: Shanghai Rhyme New Energy Technology Co., Ltd specializes in providing equipment and engineering solutions for semiconductor materials, particularly in the areas of electronic-grade silicon and high-purity electronic chemicals. Their offerings include certified cylinder products and advanced cleanroom engineering capabilities.
capabilities: Core equipment for electronic-grade silicon materials
System engineering solutions for high-purity electronic chemicals
Cleanroom engineering with Class 1000 cleaning room
Testing equipment including oxygen analyzers and particle detectors

regional_presence.China: The company is based in China and focuses on serving the domestic high-tech industry.
